messages:
tess: Pushed a slim v1.7.2 release draft focusing on adaptive routing perf tweaks and embedding streaming opt-ins. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2150
mohit: quick scan 94 hero + bullets look good. noticed some index->section links on /changelog jumping to top on preview.
iren: same. linkcheck flagged missing anchors for 'adaptive routing improvements' and 'embedding streaming opt-in'.
alon: probable cause: different slug generation after markdown dependency bump. old anchors used simple ascii slug, new one preserves accents and changes normalization.
tess: added a Known issues bullet in the draft: "Changelog anchors may not resolve on preview due to heading id normalization changes. Workaround: use browser find or direct permalink. Fix deploying."
mohit: also updated Python/TS SDK snippets to the new client signature (model_id) and added a small code diff under "Developer notes".
docs-bot: Preview: https://deploy-preview-2150--docs.redwood.com  linkcheck: 2 broken anchors
docs-bot: ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #adaptive-routing-improvements
docs-bot: ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #embedding-streaming-opt-in
alon: i'll add a tiny slugify script in build and a redirect table for legacy anchors. will open PR for the redirect table so prod links stay stable.
iren: please add a short migration line in the release notes mentioning redirect behavior so integrators know why permalinks changed.
mohit: ETA on redirect PR? if quick we can remove the Known issues note before publish.
alon: opening PR 2151 with redirects + slugify shim now, should be merged in next deploy window (~45m).
tess: thanks all 94 i'll finish copy + legal check and re-run linkcheck after PR2151 merges. closing for now unless more fails appear.
